# Managers and Leaders

> Australia & New Zealand's premier leadership and management training provider offering accredited courses, professional development, and mentoring for managers at all levels.

Managers and Leaders (IML) is a leading professional development organization specializing in evidence-based leadership training with CPMgr and Chartered Manager accreditations. The platform serves individual professionals and corporate clients across Australia and New Zealand with comprehensive courses, short programs, and mentoring services.

## Key Topics

- Leadership Development
- Management Training
- Certified Practising Manager (CPMgr)
- Chartered Manager
- Professional Accreditation
- New Manager Training
- Management Essentials
- Foundations of Intentional Leadership
- Accelerate Executive Program
- Emotional Intelligence
- Corporate Membership
- In-House Training
- Mentoring Programs
- Australia & New Zealand
- Professional Development

## Core Learning Programs

- [Learning and Development Hub](https://managersandleaders.com.au/learning-and-development): Main learning & development hub featuring management and leadership courses
- [Complete Course Catalog](https://managersandleaders.com.au/learning-and-development/courses): Complete course catalog with CPMgr accreditation and professional development
- [New Manager Course](https://managersandleaders.com.au/learning-and-development/courses/new-manager): New Manager course: practical skills for first-time leadership transitions
- [Management Essentials](https://managersandleaders.com.au/learning-and-development/courses/management-essentials): Management Essentials: two-day course on practical leadership skills
- [Foundations of Intentional Leadership](https://managersandleaders.com.au/learning-and-development/courses/foundations): Foundations: 12-week evidence-based leadership with CPMgr certification
- [Accelerate Executive Program](https://managersandleaders.com.au/learning-and-development/courses/accelerate): Accelerate: senior leader development with emotional intelligence coaching

## Professional Accreditations

- [Accreditations Overview](https://managersandleaders.com.au/learning-and-development/accreditations): Professional accreditations: CPMgr and Chartered Manager credentials
- [Certified Practising Manager (CPMgr)](https://managersandleaders.com.au/learning-and-development/accreditations/certified-practising-manager): CPMgr accreditation pathway and professional management benchmark
- [Chartered Manager Accreditation](https://managersandleaders.com.au/learning-and-development/accreditations/chartered-manager): Chartered Manager accreditation via CMI with Royal Charter recognition

## Short Courses & Development

- [Online Short Courses](https://managersandleaders.com.au/learning-and-development/short-courses): Online short courses on resilience, communication, and workplace skills
- [Mentoring Program](https://managersandleaders.com.au/membership-community/mentoring): Mentoring program connecting leaders with experienced industry mentors
- [Learning & Development Resources](https://managersandleaders.com.au/resources/learning-and-development-resources): Free leadership tools: decision-making, delegation, and change templates

## Corporate Solutions

- [For Organisations](https://managersandleaders.com.au/for-organisations): Corporate training solutions for in-house and tailored programs
- [In-House Training Programs](https://managersandleaders.com.au/for-organisations/in-house-courses): In-house training programs tailored for organizations of all sizes
- [HR Manager Training](https://managersandleaders.com.au/for-organisations/hr-managers): HR-focused leadership development and competency framework training
- [Corporate Membership](https://managersandleaders.com.au/membership-community/corporate-membership): Corporate membership package with team development and training discounts
